categories.name: Automotive
categories.definition: Questions and tasks related to vehicle maintenance, fuel, performance, and repairs.

categories.name: Navigation & Travel
categories.definition: Requests for directions, traffic updates, travel planning, booking transportation, and information about destinations.

categories.name: Reservations & Appointments
categories.definition: Managing bookings for dining, hotels, meetings, or other scheduled appointments.

categories.name: General Information & Knowledge
categories.definition: Requests for facts, definitions, calculations, recipes, jokes, general knowledge, or recommendations.

categories.name: Personal Assistant & Device Control
categories.definition: Commands and inquiries related to the assistant's settings, identity, alarms, timers, reminders, device location, communication, and general conversational interactions.

categories.name: Shopping & Ordering
categories.definition: Requests for product information, reviews, managing shopping lists, placing orders for goods or services, and tracking orders.

categories.name: Work & HR
categories.definition: Inquiries and tasks related to employment, such as vacation requests, paid time off, and HR information.
